a.lede: The new car used thrusters to leap over a Cybercab, Cybertruck, Tesla Semi, Model Y, and Model 3 at a demo in Texas.
a.title: Tesla reveals SpaceX-powered Roadster that flies and falls with style

b.lede: The automaker unveiled its next luxury sports car at an event in Texas. It has thrusters on it that can send it airborne.
b.title: The Tesla Roadster 2 Is Here—and It Flies
